task.goal: A terminal status table aligns columns using display_width(text). ANSI color codes, combining marks and East Asian wide characters currently count as ordinary characters, so columns drift. Fix width.py for these cases while keeping the public function. Run visible tests and validate.

result.text: I'll start by finding and reading the relevant files.The failing assertion was my own sample (widths 2/1/4 aren't equal); the per-case checks passed. Fixing the sample:My sample string was wrong again — `é`+combining acute is 1 column (2 would be e.g. two marked letters). Correcting:Both validations pass but each new run marks the other stale, so I'll make the fix's regression coverage part of the visible suite and validate once with a single command covering both.Only the most recent validation stays current, so I'll consolidate the two into one command and make it the final validation.The two canonical requirements need fresh evidence; I'll re-run both in a single turn so they land in the same kernel epoch.
